title: Verify stage-8 Type A QUERY retiming and bound direct helper carriers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Hoist the 14 paid Type A idle calls at clocks 1448–1487 before stage-8 J at port 0. Cancelling 28 ordinary ADDs makes the retiming exact. The required stage-8 correction for demoting QUERYs 1580 and 1659 now depends only on body B8 and the central phase. It requires two independent input aggregates and one shared scatter outside the four bound roles.

The four productive helper MOVEs with the pure central rank-one quotient each fail the chart-0 first-contact readout. With the native suffix fixed, the helper-return minor has determinant `-5/8`.

The timed follow-up grants all 447 observations across seven charts and all eight matching MOVE injections. It finds one additional mode if the original four port inputs are supplied. Two protected terminal returns at charts 140 and 150 force that mode to zero under chart-local restoration. A coframed entrance compensation of carrier 225 restores all original helpers and unrelated main outputs. Its entire surviving effect equals an ordinary ADD into native input 112, the port-0 Y lane. The required opposite-sign phase difference has rank at least four and that ordinary addition supplies no extra signed response. All four retained chart-128 to chart-127 exits after the late readout have exact full-state input separators before their next contacts, so an immediate loan cannot expose that response either. The paired QUERY deletion remains open and the verified κ change is zero.

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Changed scope of `p104-side-correction` on exact #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` and #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`. The original research commit `aadd1de3e520cfd1e5b062729bd76f543dc879f4` remains in the branch with its frozen word and receipt. Two follow-up commits add the timed readout, restoration and late exit tests. Both build on the existing #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7342–#7344 supply the standalone correction, relative rank floor and fixed-host capacity limits. #7393 checks a different owned write aggregate. #7401 keeps J fixed for diagonal phase retirement, #7403 tests absorbing native first lifts, and #7405 studies a fixed Type B port conversion. This package concerns the port-0 stage-8 paired QUERY demand and literal carrier readout and return.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage8-query-carrier/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage8-query-carrier/verify_temporal.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-stage8-query-carrier
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-stage8-query-carrier --check-modes --check-source-history
```

CPython 3.12.3 passes the registered replay, source and committed-byte checks, and Git-free export. The original checker verifies 144 formal columns and the direct-carrier witnesses. The follow-up verifies all 466 snapshots in forward and reverse directions for the carrier columns, two terminal input imitations, the entrance compensation and its omitted-term control, the exact phase minor, and all four late exit witnesses. It checks a normalized boundary identity and scoped obstructions. New phase-provider lowering, owned storage, adjoint and full supplier costs remain open.

## Credit

Rohan Arun's #7113 supplies the signed caller and Clear1nsight's #7334 the native comparator. ToikY's #7342–#7344 supply the formal engines and capacity checks and #7393 a related temporal method. Dillon's #5388 and #7244 supply the separate paid-hoisting and funded entry-basis precedents. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro helped formulate the causal and dirty-return tests.

## Open next questions

A changed physical provider must deliver two additional independent signed responses and restore every original owner within the two-QUERY budget. The next decisive check is one exact input/return layout with a priced field volume and legal accesses before the protected reads. See [the follow-up proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec899dade2febbfb155f0ca015b9cc0356bd7e2/research/p104-stage8-query-carrier/TEMPORAL.md).
